fields.name: Cause value
fields.description: Indicates the reason why a session management request is rejected

notes: The ESM cause information element is coded as shown in figure 9.9.4.4.1 and table 9.9.4.4.1
The ESM cause is a type 3 information element with 2 octets length
The purpose of the ESM cause information element is to indicate the reason why a session management request is rejected
